summary: Assess ABS collateral, model waterfalls, stress cash flows, and strengthen surveillance. Explore this five-day practitioner-focused course.
lede: Asset-backed securities analysis assesses how collateral performance and transaction terms shape investor cash flows. Designed for intermediate credit, investment and structured-finance practitioners, the course supports reviewing securitisation exposures when pool data is incomplete or delayed. Participants practise checking collateral and cash-flow data, modelling waterfalls, testing default and prepayment scenarios, assessing structural protections and concentrations, and preparing surveillance and credit reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate practitioners who review collateral pools, transaction documents, cash flows, and securitisation exposures as part of credit, investment, structuring, or surveillance work.
audience: Credit Risk Analysts in asset-backed finance
prerequisites: Working knowledge of credit analysis, fixed-income instruments, and spreadsheet-based analysis is recommended. No programming is required.
